comments.body: Tbh if it's an emergency and you have no alternative then go for it. I'm currently living in one of their houses but I can't wait to move out. They have the worst customer care I've ever experiences in my life. We pay for cleaning which isn't provided. Their way of dealing with these situations is just threatening people to throw them out. No answers, no explanation. I even contacted the ceo (John Trajkov) of the firm hoping to receive answers but nothing changed. If you can stay away from them.
comments.author: Severe-Beach-2585
